opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 918 vs price 530 - margin of safety 42.2%

opportunities.point: The company remains confident of achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY30.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "With improving industry sentiment, expanding opportunities across domestic and export markets, and strong execution momentum, we remain confident of achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY ‘30, exceeding our earlier target." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The management expects Start of Production for the Turkey program during FY27 and for the Indian customer program during FY28.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We expect SOP, Start of Production, for the Turkey program during FY ‘27, while the Indian customer program is expected to enter production by FY ‘28." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: During FY26, the company deployed capex of approximately INR417 million.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "During FY ‘26, we deployed capex approximately of INR417 million towards new telescopic handler axle production, high-performance transmission programs, incremental manufacturing capacity expansion." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: For FY27, capex is confirmed to be around INR130 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Yes, we confirm that amount, more on the INR130 crores than INR140 crores, but we will be in that range." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Debt is being paid down - interest cost should keep falling.
The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 10.5% earnings growth vs 98% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: A automobile & auto components tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Domestic construction equipment industry volumes declined by approximately 2% year-on-year due to slower infrastructure execution.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "On the construction equipment side, the domestic market remained relatively soft, with industry volumes declining by approximately 2% year-on-year due to slower infrastructure execution and delays in project activity during parts of the year." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Exports from India grew by nearly 32% in the construction equipment segment.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "However, exports from India remained robust, growing by nearly 32%, reflecting improving global demand for Indian-manufactured construction equipment and strengthening India's position as an export hub." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company secured a business nomination for a major OEM for bull gears valued at approximately INR150 million annually starting FY28.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "During the year, we secured a business nomination for a major OEM for bull gears, valued at approximately INR150 million annually starting FY ‘28." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Engineering services reported revenues of approximately INR100 million during FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Engineering services business continued to gain traction and reported revenues of approximately INR100 million during FY ‘26." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.78 pp, DII -0.52 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Any sustained rise in energy prices or supply chain volatility could lead to production and supply-related impact, especially in H1 FY27.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Any sustained rise in energy prices or supply chain volatility could lead to some production and supply-related impact, especially in H1 FY ‘27 and potentially extend to H2 if the situation persists longer than anticipated." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The gear business remained subdued during 9 months FY 2026, and near-term growth is likely to remain muted.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The gear business remained subdued during 9 months FY 2026. Although near-term growth is likely to remain muted, ongoing initiatives to strengthen the business are expected to drive gradual improvement in the coming quarters." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.
